# cat-harness-upstream

The pinned-upstream registry, `upstream-pins.json` (`"$schema": "folio-upstream-pins/v1"`): one row per upstream dependency the build pins — the just-the-docs theme, the Bun runtime, the pdf.js viewer — naming the file the pin is READ from (`pinnedIn`, resolved against this instance's root), the pattern that reads it, what of ours binds to the dependency and the MVP that must pass before it moves. It deliberately holds no version: that lives in the file the build reads. Read by `bun run check:upstream-pins` (weekly, `.github/workflows/upstream-pins.yml`) and worked by the `upstream-pin-watch` / `upstream-version-adoption` processes and skill this instance owns. Moved here from the repository root on 2026-10-06 (bean `ar1s`, phase 3: tooling leaves the root before the repo split). HERE rather than in the tool layer because this instance's processes, skills and scripts name it, and a harness file naming a file in the layer above is a wrong-direction reference (`check:reference-direction`). `code`: the checker's input table, authored beside the processes that read it, not content any reader renders.

Part of [C@T Harness](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `cat-harness-upstream`, holding `code`.
